spans.s: सा॑ध m. performance, accomplishment.
1 सधन n. common wealth.

2 सधन a. wealthy (abstr. ˚ता f.) or along with the
wealth.
सा॑धान a. with the receptacle.

सधम॑द् (सध˚मा॑द्) m. boon-companion, fellow,
friend.

सधमा॑द m. compotation, banquet, feast;
 fellowship.
सधमादिन् m. = सधम॑द्.
1 सधर्म m. equal nature, similarity.

2 सधर्म a. equal, similar;
 honest, virtuous.

सधर्मचारिणी f. wife, lit. performing the same
duties (scil. as the husband).
सधर्मत्व n. similarity, likeness.

सधर्मन् a. equal, similar, resembling (gen., instr.,
or —˚).

सध˚र्मिन् a. equal, similar, resembling (gen., instr.,
or —˚).
†सधवीर a. united with men or heroes.

1 सध॑स्तुति f. united praise, as instr. adv. along
with united praise.
2 †सधस्तुति a. receiving united praise.
सध॑स्तुत्य n. = prec. 1.

स॑धिस् n. aim or goal (of a motion), point or place (of
rest).
स॑धी a. furnished with intelligence.
स॑धूम a. veiled in smoke.
सध्री॑ adv. towards one goal (central point).
2 साध् v. यज्ञसा॑ध्.
सा॑धदिष्टि a. whose sacrifice or prayer has effect.
साधनक्षम a. provable, demonstrable.
साधनाध्यक्ष m. inspector of the military force.

साधनीय a. to be accomplished, acquired, or proved;
abstr. ˚त्व n.
साधर्म्य n. similarity, likeness.
साधिक a. with a surplus, — and more.
साधिदैवत a. having a tutelary deity in (instr.).
साधिन् a. accomplishing, performing (—˚).
सा॑धिष्ठ superl. & compar. to seq.
साधीयंस् superl. & compar. to seq.
साधु॑कर्मन् a. acting well or properly.
साधुकारि॑न् a. = prec., skilful, clever.
साधु˚कृ॑त् a. = prec., skilful, clever.
साधुजन m. a good man (or woman*).
साधुतस् adv. from good people.
साधुता f. ˚त्व n., ˚भाव m. abstr. to साधु॑.
साधुया॑ adv. straight, directly, regularly, well.

साधुवाद m. right expression, good renown, also =
साधुशब्द.
साधुवादिन् a. speaking right or applauding.
साधुवाहिन् a. well drawing (a waggon).
साधुशब्द m. cry of good or bravo.

साधुशील a. having a good character;
 abstr. ˚त्व n.
साधुसंस्कृत॑ a. well arranged or prepared.
साध्या॑ adv. = साधुया॑.
साध्यवन्त् a. containing what is to be proved.

साध्यवसाना f. a kind of elliptical expression
((rh.)).

साध्यव˚सानिका f. a kind of elliptical expression
((rh.)).
साध्वर्य॑ a. faithfully devoted.

साध्वस n. perplexity, perturbation, fear, terror,
timidity, shyness.
साध्वसाधु॑ a. good and (or) bad.
साध्वसाराधन n. a timid beginning.
1 साध्वाचार m. the conduct of the good or good conduct.
2 साध्वाचार a. well-conducted, virtuous.
साध्वीक (adj. —˚) = साध्वी, v. साधु॑.
